d: What if your next playground was to build a global, iconic Brand, with a creative machine that never sleeps, and compounds?
We’re not looking for a "Social Media Manager" to follow a calendar. We’re looking for an AI-native Creative Director (Brand & Content).
Someone who understands that to win today, you don’t just need "content", you need a Movement.

This isn’t another content job. Most content teams use AI to write captions faster. That’s the 99%. We want to be in the 0.1%: a media where AI runs the creative loop, from the signal to the hook, the cut, the post and the lesson. Every day, on every platform, in French and in English. You bring the taste. The machine you build brings the scale.
Here’s the bet: a company that learns by itself grows in a way a company of people alone can’t. We aim for $10M in revenue with 10 people, each of them running a dozen agents.
What Ai-native Content Means At Paradox 🤖
Paradoxically, the more AI runs our content, the more human it has to feel. AI doesn’t make more of what everyone makes. It makes more of what only we can make.
Our creative machine has to be able to
Read the signals. Comments, DMs, retention graphs, saves, shares, search trends, objections from sales calls, and what the best creators and advertisers in the world are publishing right now.
Hold the full context of Paradox. Our DNA, years of interviews, lives and courses, member stories, and every past post with what it taught us, in one shared company brain.
Generate in our voice. Hooks, scripts, shorts, carousels, cuts, thumbnails and captions, in French and in English.
Ship. Format, schedule, publish and answer, on every platform.
Measure with real KPIs. Retention, shares, saves, follower growth, and the followers who become leads and members. Not likes.
Learn and loop on its own. Double down on what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and start the next cycle without waiting for a meeting.

This is already real. An ads library of thousands of creatives feeds our creative research. Agents cut ads from long-form content and wire Instagram comment-to-DM automations. And our product is AI-native too: Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day.
At Paradox, we are convinced that greatness is trainable, and we believe self-help is broken.
Most learning platforms are used the same way: consuming generic theories, getting quick highs, ending with no real change.
People deserve more: a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.
That’s why we want to empower people at scale, by leveraging cutting edge technologies like AI, and crafting user experiences with outstanding aesthetics.
Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)
To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS.

Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world.
q: Proven Content Builder: You have successfully grown a media brand, a YouTube channel, or a personal brand to significant scale (100k+ followers or millions of views). You understand the mechanics of virality and retention. You’ve created at least one format that broke out, and you can show its click-through and retention numbers.
Elite Scripting Skills: You can show us scripts you wrote that performed. You know how to structure a narrative, write a hook that stops the scroll, and keep an audience engaged for 20+ minutes.
Performance Fluency: You have worked in environments where content had to drive business results (ads, launches, conversion), not just vanity metrics.
AI-native Creative: you’ve built content pipelines with AI yourself: Claude Code, automations, generative video, image and voice tools, evals. Show us something you built, not a certificate.
Intolerant to Mediocrity: You have "Taste." You are physically pained by a bad font, a clumsy cut, or a weak headline. You fight for the details that others ignore, including in what AI produces.
Psychology Obsessed: You don’t just "make content"; you study human nature. You constantly ask why people click, why they share, and what emotion drives them.
A "Doer" with Authority: You command respect not by title, but by competence. You can jump into a project, write the script, direct the shoot, and fix the edit if needed.
Loop thinker: you see every platform as a loop that can learn, and you can’t stop yourself from closing it.

No Ego, Just Impact: You don’t fall in love with your ideas. You accept that even the best concepts can flop. When it happens, you don’t take it personally; you analyze the data, pivot immediately, and ship the next concept with renewed energy.
English: Fluent English, you can hold a conversation on specific details with English-speaking colleagues.
Our chosen language for written communication is English.
IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU
❌ If you need clarity before chaos: wrong place.
❌ If you prefer balance over intensity: wrong season.
❌ If you don’t genuinely care about the topics we cover: wrong place.
r: You lead the Content Factory not by management, but with creativity.
Your goal is to produce content that is so good, unique, and aligned with our values that people would cry if they had to unsubscribe.

In a classic content team, people do the work and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the volume, you design the machine, set the bar and make the calls. Humans do what no machine can: taste.
Build a symbiotic strategy where David Laroche’s personal brand and Paradox’s company brand reinforce each other without cannibalization.
Implement radical new formats (documentaries, conceptual shorts) that shatter the boring codes of the "Self-Help" industry.
Define distinct, sharp editorial lines for each platform: Depth & Search for YouTube, Aesthetic & Vibe for Instagram, and Authority & Authenticity for LinkedIn.
❌ The old way: a strategy deck written once a year, and a calendar filled by habit.

🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: agents watch every platform, every competitor and every comment continuously. They tell you which angle is rising, which format is tiring and which story our audience asks for. The strategy updates every week, on evidence.
Take responsibility for the entire production chain from hooks to storyboarding the narrative, and ensuring the final cut matches the vision.
Own the packaging: titles, thumbnails and the first 3 seconds. You test variants every week and know your click-through and retention numbers by heart.
❌ The old way: one shoot becomes one video and a handful of posts.

🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: one shoot, one live or one interview becomes dozens of hooks, shorts, carousels and ad cuts by the next morning, in both languages. Concepts are tested with AI-generated drafts before we spend a day shooting them.
Build the Content Factory: humans and agents

Your taste becomes the eval. You write down what makes a great hook, a great cut, a great carousel and a great story, in rules and examples the agents check themselves against. Each time you reject something, the reason goes back into the rules.
Act as the final quality check: nothing gets published if it doesn’t meet the "Paradox Standard" of aesthetics and storytelling, whether a person or an agent made it.
❌ The old way: a creative team briefs an editor, waits three days and gets two versions.
🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: agents draft, cut, caption, translate and schedule. You keep the best, and next week their first drafts are already closer to your bar.
Analyze retention graphs, CTR, and CPL to iterate based on feedback, killing what fails and aggressively scaling what works.
❌ The old way: someone pulls the stats at the end of the month and nobody changes anything.

🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: agents read the numbers of every post every day, explain why it worked or didn’t, and propose the next test. You measure the machine itself: posts per week, time from idea to live, hit rate, and the share of the work done without a human.
Go global, and keep the soul
We started in French. You build the machine that takes Paradox to English-speaking audiences: channels, formats and voice that feel native, not translated.
And always: real stories told with consent, no fake claims, no fake scarcity. The machine can scale, but it doesn’t decide what’s right. You do.
How you’ll know you’re AI-native: you spend your time on concepts, taste and calls, not on resizing, captioning and exporting. The output grows every month while the team doesn’t.
x: Help us market a product that fuses neuroscience, design, and AI to reinvent how humans grow.

d: Role Description The Cloud Engineer role at DT FIN-CON is a part-time remote position focused on designing, implementing, and maintaining cloud-based infrastructure to support the club’s digital initiatives. Daily responsibilities include configuring and managing cloud environments, ensuring system reliability, performance, and security, and collaborating with student teams to deploy and optimize applications used for events, competitions, and learning resources. The Cloud Engineer will help set up scalable infrastructure for web platforms, databases, and analytics tools, while monitoring usage, costs, and resource allocation. The role also involves documenting architecture, creating basic automation scripts, and recommending improvements to enhance efficiency and resilience of the club’s technology stack.
q: Candidates should possess skills in Cloud Computing and Infrastructure, including experience with major cloud platforms and basic networking concepts.
Candidates should possess skills in Software Development, with the ability to write, test, and deploy code or scripts to support cloud-based applications.
Candidates should possess skills in working with Linux environments, including command-line operations, system configuration, and basic security practices.
Candidates should possess skills in Databases, such as designing schemas, managing cloud-hosted databases, and optimizing queries for performance.
Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, containerization (e.g., Docker), and version control (e.g., Git) is beneficial.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and the capacity to work independently in a remote, student-driven environment.
Current enrollment in or completion of a relevant program (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, or Digital Transformation) is preferred but not mandatory.

d: Bayut & dubizzle have the unique distinction of being iconic, homegrown brands with a strong presence across the seven emirates in the UAE. Connecting millions of users across the country, we are committed to delivering the best online search experience.

As part of Dubizzle Group, we are alongside some of the strongest classified brands in the market. With a collective strength of 5 brands, we have more than 123 million monthly users that trust in our dedication to providing them with the best platform for their needs.

As a Sales Executive - Inside Sales, you will play a pivotal role in maintaining strong relationships with customers while leveraging your sales expertise to upsell dubizzle car services. You will understand customer needs, offer tailored solutions, and consistently exceed sales targets mostly through telephonic interactions and field visits where required.
q: High school diploma or equivalent (Bachelor's degree preferred)
4 to 5 years of proven experience in a similar inside sales or telesales role
Experience in selling used cars, car insurances, service/warranties, insurance and car financing is a plus
Familiarity with the automotive market and value-added services (e.g., car insurance, warranties)
Strong communication and persuasive skills with a knack for closing deals
Excellent negotiation and objection-handling skills to maximize sales outcomes
Highly organized with aggressive follow-up capabilities to meet deadlines and targets
Ability to manage and maintain high call volumes and closures
r: Drive the full sales cycle from prospecting to closing, ensuring a seamless customer experience
Effectively identify and qualify prospects using a variety of lead sources, including cold, warm, and hot leads
Consult with customers to understand their needs and recommend the best value-added services and packages
Present tailored proposals and maintain professional communication through emails and calls and text messaging
Build and maintain strong, long-lasting customer relationships
Ensure customers are offered the best deals by understanding their specific needs and preferences
Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, providing ongoing support and solutions
Consistently meet and exceed individual and team sales targets
Maintain detailed and accurate records of interactions, opportunities, and sales outcomes in CRM
Provide actionable feedback to sales management to enhance the sales cycle, improve offerings, and strengthen the company's market presence
Stay updated on market trends, customer preferences, and competitors' offerings
Act as a positive representative of the Dubizzle Cars brand, upholding the company's reputation in all interactions
Conduct sales activities with the highest levels of professionalism and integrity
x: A fast paced, high performing team
Multicultural environment with over 60 different nationalities
Employee discounts at multiple vendors across the emirates
Bayut & dubizzle is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

d: We are currently looking for an enthusiastic, vigilant, and committed Security professional who is passionate about safety and hospitality and eager to grow their career with us.

As a Security Officer, you will be responsible for protecting and safeguarding our guests, colleagues, visitors, and hotel assets, while maintaining a secure and welcoming environment. You will combine professionalism, attentiveness, and a service-oriented approach to ensure that safety and security standards are consistently maintained throughout the hotel.
q: You should ideally be a certified Security Officer with previous experience in hotel security, hospitality security, or a similar security environment.
Additional certifications in First Aid, CPR, emergency response, fire safety, or the use of an Automated External Defibrillator (AED) will be considered an advantage.

A good command of written and spoken English is essential, together with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally with guests, colleagues, and relevant authorities when required. You should be committed to following safety and security policies, procedures, and established protocols consistently and without compromise.
The ideal candidate will be a hands-on, vigilant, and dependable professional with a positive, proactive, and flexible approach to work.

You should be comfortable working in a busy hotel environment, remain calm and composed during emergencies or challenging situations, and demonstrate a high level of attention to detail, observation, and situational awareness. A professional and service-oriented approach is essential when interacting with guests and colleagues.
You should possess the following key competencies
r: Conduct regular security patrols and surveillance rounds throughout the hotel to ensure the safety and security of guests, colleagues, visitors, and hotel property.
Respond promptly and professionally to emergency and non-emergency situations , providing assistance in a calm and hospitable manner.
Identify and report safety hazards, suspicious activities, unauthorized visitors, aggressive behavior, or other security concerns and take appropriate action.
Receive and document reports relating to lost property, theft, damage, or other security incidents , conducting appropriate follow-up and investigation as required.
Monitor designated hotel areas through the CCTV surveillance system and promptly report any irregularities.
Ensure fire exits, emergency access points, and evacuation routes remain clear and unobstructed at all times.
Regularly check that fire and safety equipment is available, accessible, and maintained in its designated location.
Support the hotel's emergency response and evacuation procedures when required.
Maintain accurate security logs, incident reports, and other required documentation.
Assist guests and colleagues in a courteous, discreet, and professional manner , while maintaining appropriate security protocols.
Maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment when dealing with sensitive security matters.
Perform all duties consistently in accordance with the hotel’s security standards, policies, procedures, and applicable legal and statutory requirements .
Work closely with other departments to maintain a safe, secure, and welcoming hotel environment for everyone.
